name: What questions should I ask a luxury home builder in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What are the most important questions to ask a luxury home builder before starting a new construction project in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What are the most important questions to ask a luxury home builder before starting a new construction project in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury home builder should be able to explain not only how the house will look, but how the project will be managed from design through final punch list. Ask for examples of similar homes in your area, especially if your lot has slopes, tight access, or strict neighborhood constraints. Clarify who manages permits, how the schedule is updated, and how budget overruns are controlled. You should also ask what is excluded from the proposal, how allowances are set for finishes, and how change orders are approved. In luxury projects, communication is just as important as craftsmanship, because small decisions can affect both schedule and cost. The right builder should give you a clear process for design coordination, procurement, inspections, and warranty support. If a contractor cannot explain these steps clearly, that is a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about recent similar projects, permitting experience, budget control, timeline, warranty coverage, allowance management, subcontractor quality, and who handles communication. You should also ask what is included in the bid, how change orders are priced, and whether the builder has experience with hillside, infill, or high-end custom homes.
